{{Top|leg}}
'''The smuggling guilds''' was an unofficial term that was used on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] by various groups that controlled most [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] operations in some sectors of the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]].
